entry_state: Reconstruction begins with immutable filings and reviewed readings, retains residuals and joint symbolic families, and labels scoped search limits. A run supplies explicit conditional assumptions and information permissions. Event scheduling and atomic commit now preserve economic state, posting and replay identity; the detailed separation of assessment, posting permission and economic delta is still being developed.
exit_state: An admitted event basis and separate posting authorization must bind both journal and economic delta. Exact retry preserves the original receipt, while changed payloads and stale heads have distinct outcomes. Funding loops retain solvability and default distinctions; loan, bond and equity examples connect events to statements. Reporting preserves basis and provenance without claiming that lineage proves the economic model correct.
findings: A synthetic teaching basis cannot authorize a real book. False required facts, unknown facts and out-of-scope events retain distinct assessments.
The four commit references and Figure 8.1 connect economic event, permission, journal/delta and atomic receipt. An assessment cannot become an authorization by changing a flag.
Stable business-event identity is separate from the full fingerprint. Replay lookup before head freshness permits recovery after a lost acknowledgement without permitting changed requests.
The loan branches balance at cash 90/88 and equity -10/-12; the bond schedule separates noncash accretion from redemption. Reporting classifications remain profile-dependent.
No new confirmed defect in pages 108–110; the figure, pseudocode continuation and financial tables are legible.
